scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix web test && DOTNET_CLI_HOME="${DOTNET_CLI_HOME:-$HOME}" dotnet test CareerPlatform.sln -c Release
scripts.verify: npm --prefix web run verify && ./web/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && DOTNET_CLI_HOME="${DOTNET_CLI_HOME:-$HOME}" dotnet test CareerPlatform.sln -c Release
